name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA that allows two parties to disclose confidential information to each other in connection with a shared purpose, such as evaluating a potential business relationship. Created by Common Paper with a committee of over 40 attorneys.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use of the service, support, payment, data privacy, warranties, liability, and indemnification.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement that gives an early customer or design partner access to a product in exchange for feedback, allowing a provider to develop and improve the product before general availability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: A companion agreement to the Cloud Service Agreement that sets uptime and support response time targets and the service credits a customer can receive if those targets are not met.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: A framework agreement for engaging professional services under one or more statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, intellectual property, payment, warranties, and liability.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A DPA that governs how a service provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including subprocessors, international data transfers (EEA SCCs and UK Addendum), security incident response, and audit rights.

name: Software License Agreement
description: A standard agreement for licensing on-premises or self-hosted software, covering license grants, restrictions, updates, warranties, limitation of liability, and indemnification.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A flexible agreement for business partnerships that involve mutual obligations, such as co-marketing or referral arrangements, including trademark licensing and payment terms.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term trial or evaluation agreement that lets a prospective customer test a product or service before committing to a longer-term commercial agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA-required agreement between a covered entity and a business associate that governs the use, disclosure, and protection of protected health information (PHI).

name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum that supplements a Common Paper agreement with terms specific to AI features, covering use of AI services, model training, ownership of inputs and outputs, and AI-related disclaimers.
